description: Implementation of the cu_up_connection_manager class, managing CU-UP connections, message handling, and connection lifecycle in a telecommunication system.

classes.name: cu_up_connection_manager::shared_cu_up_connection_context
classes.description: Holds context information for a CU-UP connection, including message handling and connection state.

classes.name: cu_up_connection_manager::e1_gw_to_cu_cp_pdu_adapter
classes.description: Thread-safe notifier forwarding E1AP messages from E1 GW to CU-CP.

methods.name: connect_cu_up
methods.description: Associates a CU-UP index with the connection context and retrieves its message handler.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Checks if the CU-UP repository has been created for this connection.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Removes the CU-UP repository and notifies closure.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Handles incoming E1AP messages from CU-UP.

methods.name: e1_gw_to_cu_cp_pdu_adapter
methods.description: Constructor that increments connection count and sets up message forwarding.

methods.name: on_new_message
methods.description: Dispatches received E1AP messages to CU-CP executor.
